newSharedCapabilities: Strict paired gift/reward operations reuse exact one-private-Hand selection and per-recipient Play ledger; descriptor shared legality requires owner Hand before publishing or accepting.
A real native one-entity gift issues an immutable exact-source Hand policy; original departure ledger ends its interval permanently, including later transfer or return.
Central intrinsic identity preserves entity, suit, rank and recipient actor/provider; normal Response issues no Use benefit.
Before real Use pays into Processing, the exact accepted single-entity policy is frozen on its owning CardUseFrame.
Completion candidates validate source instance, gameplay fingerprint, original entity, real owning Use and completed parent; frozen actual damage controls Draw1/Draw2 once.
Own ProgramSkillFrame gift/reward receipts await real native movement and draw children; scalar facts and omitted-null frame fields preserve collection and prior format boundaries.
Gift AI considers its real immediate cost and a bounded public future opportunity, without private foreign Hand or future deck inspection.
newBehaviorCoverage: Actual registered ol:fuman gives a printed Dodge; native AI accepts and uses the intrinsic Slash, with actual actor/provider retained as recipient.
Damage-free and damage-causing real Uses draw exactly one or two; unrelated subsequent damage does not enlarge the original reward.
Gift, committed Use, response and draw children are cold-restored with original receipts, once-paid material, once-ledger, physical sequences and typed parent returns.
Original departure by discard, third-holder transfer or returning the same entity prevents old identity/reward resurrection.
Native Duel Slash response consumes the gifted printed Duel without a Use reward; unrelated Duel damage cannot borrow it.
Real inserted Play resets per-target quota in the same actual turn; another recipient remains legal in each phase.
Empty actual Hand hides the gift, rejects command atomically and preserves target quota; real same-phase acquisition restores acceptance for that target.
A real recipient turn with skipped Play retains continuous Hand policy beyond intervening turn ends and cold restore; the next real Use rewards once.
Four player views, frozen nested collections and wrong actor/unpublished/stale command rejection retain privacy and input boundaries.
coverageLimitations: Cross-skill FAQ and current official client were not tested; old 2017 and alternate mobile/X rules are excluded.
Issued grant persistence after original runtime skill loss and donor death handling are engine interpretations, not a verified current cross-skill FAQ.
New dedicated positive skill-loss/death, Fan or multi-material Zhangba, assisted-provider and malformed receipt scenarios were not introduced.
The native recipient Use/Response paths are exercised; giver native-AI tactical quality was not newly measured.
Routine elapsed time is measured against the approximately one-minute target; existing registrations were retained.
